content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "It weighs the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain against each other, which is the chain-against-chain collision K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; two readings: the missing name is a forbidden verse-level stating-verse defect, or it is a permissible chain-footing defect.", "why": "The judge treats the challenger's footed chain as underdetermined because it 'does not name Joseph as the begetter,' which is the stating-verse test K-C retires."}
